mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON rm.role_id = r.role_id AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON ur.user_id = u.user_id AND u.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = '0' AND m.del_flag = '0' AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND status = '0' AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY parent_id, order_num
SELECT * FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND status = '0' AND del_flag = '0' AND visible = '0' ORDER BY parent_id, order_num

SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON rm.role_id = r.role_id AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON ur.user_id = u.user_id AND u.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.status = '0' AND m.del_flag = '0' AND m.visible = '0' ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num
